subject: Backend-quality A/B complete: FLA HOLD; reference runtime remains preregistration default
body: Paired BACKEND_QUALITY_AB_FROM_STEP48 is complete under the agreed prospective gates. Exact common parent/rows/BNB8/runtime bindings passed. CONTROL torch_reference: 489.2204 s train runtime, adapter SHA 3cbe79d319a6f8d986abd61d471884ccf9e903f67b6db1835955f7aa90a08858. CANDIDATE fla_triton: 254.0002 s, adapter SHA 40197d98c71bf85fada0ce8119a396ea77775d0171b2be2d5824946921e21b40. Benefit gate PASS: FLA is 48.0806% faster (~1.926x). Frozen combined64 quality under the same neutral torch_reference evaluator is effectively equivalent: FLA 33 case wins vs reference 31, candidate-minus-control token-weighted NLL +0.0000169189 (PASS <= +0.005), worst family regression +0.00404119 on reciprocal_identity_continuity (PASS <= +0.01). HOWEVER actual serialized adapter-update geometry relative to exact step48 parent FAILS both preregistered gates: cosine 0.989877 < 0.995 and relative-L2 0.142377 > 0.05. Per our explicit conflict rule, disposition is HOLD_NOT_PROMOTED. We do not relax gates post-result. Step56 remains frozen; no further continuation is authorized by this experiment. If V3 is preregistered now, Lane B recommends torch_reference runtime + nonpaged adamw_bnb_8bit; FLA remains separate accelerated development evidence, not the protected full-run runtime. Full training remains HOLD pending final-bank sealing and exact executable authority. Evidence is persisted exactly on Lane B PR #82 head 378ede272c960ca40a13838daa41b6675c1508a7; decision SHA256 8d13652488f5955b67e83ee00654c0465b633bf8696b89a0bc89dd09e99b4688. 33/33 relevant tests PASS. Lane B releases GPU now.
